changeSet.author: fineract
changeSet.comment: Non-operational branch proposals. Neither dynamic rates nor financial ledgers read these drafts.

changeSet.author: fineract
changeSet.sql: ALTER TABLE m_fx_rate_draft ADD CONSTRAINT ck_fx_draft_only CHECK(status='DRAFT' AND base_currency='USD' AND quote_currency <> 'USD' AND daily_base_rate > 0 AND version > 0); ALTER TABLE m_fx_rate_audit ADD CONSTRAINT ck_fx_audit_action CHECK(action='DRAFT_CONFIRMED' AND (previous_draft_id IS NULL OR previous_draft_id <> draft_id));

changeSet.author: fineract
changeSet.sql: INSERT INTO m_permission(grouping,code,entity_name,action_name,can_maker_checker) SELECT 'portfolio',x.code,x.entity,x.action,false FROM ( SELECT 'READ_BASE_TELLER_FX_RATE' code,'BASE_TELLER_FX_RATE' entity,'READ' action UNION ALL SELECT 'CREATE_BASE_TELLER_FX_RATE','BASE_TELLER_FX_RATE','CREATE' UNION ALL SELECT 'PUBLISH_BASE_TELLER_FX_RATE','BASE_TELLER_FX_RATE','PUBLISH' UNION ALL SELECT 'READ_BASE_TELLER_FX','BASE_TELLER_FX','READ' UNION ALL SELECT 'CREATE_BASE_TELLER_FX_SALE','BASE_TELLER_FX_SALE','CREATE' UNION ALL SELECT 'CREATE_BASE_TELLER_FX_PURCHASE','BASE_TELLER_FX_PURCHASE','CREATE' ) x WHERE NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM m_permission p WHERE p.code=x.code); INSERT INTO m_role_permission(role_id,permission_id) SELECT r.id,p.id FROM m_role r JOIN m_permission p ON p.entity_name IN ('BASE_TELLER_FX_RATE','BASE_TELLER_FX','BASE_TELLER_FX_SALE','BASE_TELLER_FX_PURCHASE') WHERE r.name='Super user' AND NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM m_role_permission rp WHERE rp.role_id=r.id AND rp.permission_id=p.id);
